info.title: Zettelrobbe API Documentation
info.description: API documentation for the Zettelrobbe application

BearerAuth.description:
JWT-based authentication for web app users. The token is obtained by authenticating via the login endpoint.

### How to authenticate:
1. Send a POST request to `/login` with your username and password
2. The server will respond with a JWT token (also set as a cookie in browsers)
3. Include this token in the `Authorization` header as `Bearer {token}`

Example:
```
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...
```

JWT tokens are valid for 24 hours after issuance.

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description:
API key authentication for programmatic access. The API key can be generated or regenerated using the /api/key-regenerate endpoint.

### How to authenticate:
1. Access the API key from your application settings
2. Include the API key in the `x-api-key` HTTP header for all requests

Example:
```
x-api-key: 7c1f3f5e2b0a9d8c6e4b2a1d3f5e8c9b2a1d3f5e
```

API keys do not expire unless regenerated.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values for the document

promptTokens.description: Number of tokens in the prompt

status.description:
Overall system health. `degraded` means the database is fine but
the document scanner cannot work (scheduler not armed, or repeated
failed runs, e.g. an unreachable Paperless-ngx).

database.description: Result of the local database check

message.example: Document scan failed 3 time(s) in a row: connect ECONNREFUSED 172.18.0.2:8000

ScannerHealth.description: State of the periodic document scan loop

armed.description: Whether the scan cron job is scheduled

running.description: Whether a scan is currently in progress

scanInterval.description: Cron expression the scheduler was armed with

lastRunSource.description: Trigger of the last run (initial, scheduler, api-manual, ...)

consecutiveFailures.description: Number of consecutive failed scan runs

failureThreshold.description: Failures required before the scanner counts as degraded

lastError.description: Error message of the last failed run

PaperlessHealth.description:
Result of the most recent Paperless-ngx connectivity probe. The probe
runs on every scan and additionally every
`PAPERLESS_PROBE_INTERVAL_SECONDS` (default 60s), so the result stays
current even while no scan is running.

reachable.description:
Whether the host answered at all. Null until the first probe has
run. A rejected API token still counts as reachable — check
`usable` to decide whether Paperless-ngx can actually be used.

authorized.description: Whether the API token was accepted (not 401/403)

usable.description: Reachable *and* authorized — what the scan loop needs

status.description: HTTP status of the probe, null when no response arrived

EntityRecord.description:
One tag or correspondent as the Duplicates feature reads it — the
Paperless-ngx object in camelCase, with nothing added. A
DuplicateGroupMember is this record plus its score inside a group.

userCanChange.description: false when the API token may not modify the object

DuplicateGroupMember.description: One tag or correspondent inside a duplicate group

userCanChange.description: false when the API token may not modify the object

id.description: kind plus the member ids in ascending order

source.description: present in an AI review result; ai-candidate groups scored below the threshold and were confirmed by the model

tags.description: tags loaded from Paperless-ngx (null when not scanned)

dismissedPairs.description: pairs hidden because the user marked them as not duplicates

paperlessUrl.description: public Paperless-ngx base URL the page links its entries to

unused.description: objects of the scanned kinds that carry no document; inbox and configured tags are never listed

sourceIds.description: objects whose documents move to the target and which are deleted afterwards

targetName.description: a new name for the target, applied before the merge; empty or absent keeps its name

copyMatchingRule.description: copy a source's matching rule to the target when the target has none

deleted.description: false when the source was skipped or the merge stopped before deleting it

mergeId.description: id of the log entry, usable for an undo

EntityMergeLogEntry.description: One merge as recorded locally, with everything an undo needs

targetBefore.description: the target's matching rule before the merge

snapshot.description: the source object as it was before deletion

documentsAlreadyOnTarget.description: tags only; documents that carried the target before the merge

copiedMatchingRule.description: true on the one source whose matching rule was copied to the target

action.description: what the row records; a delete row lists the removed objects as its sources and can be undone like a merge

details.description:
What a split did, per document, so an undo can put exactly that
back: the topic tags it added and the document type it set.
Null for merges and deletes.

createdTypeId.description: a document type the split created, deleted again by the undo

createdTagIds.description: topic tags the split created, deleted again by the undo

targetRenamedFrom.description: the target's name before this merge renamed it; null when it did not

performedBy.description: who asked for the undo (username, or api-key)

restoredId.description: the re-created object's new id, or the id of a same-named object that existed again

adoptedExisting.description: true when a same-named object existed again and was reused instead of created

documentsSkipped.description: documents that no longer exist or no longer carry the target

AiVerdict.description: What the AI provider said about a pair or a group; null when nothing was asked

reason.description: one short sentence from the model

basis.description: the rule the model applied; one of case-or-spacing, umlaut, legal-form, plural, abbreviation, translation, synonym, typo, different-thing, different-topic, insufficient-evidence, or null when the model gave none

confidence.description: how sure the model is; the AI proposal pre-ticks only same with high

source.description: spelling-rule when the matcher's hard tier settled the pair and the model was not asked

remembered.description: true when the verdict came from the judge's memory of an earlier review instead of a request

withTitles.description: give the model a few recent document titles per entity as context

groupIds.description: judge only these groups of the scan (ids as the scan returned them); other groups come back without a verdict

minConfidence.description: judge only groups whose confidence is at least this value (0.5 to 1); combined with groupIds both must hold

includeCandidates.description: false skips the band of near-misses below the threshold, so only scan groups are judged

withExcerpts.description: give the model short content excerpts of a couple of documents per entity for pairs the matcher linked by spelling alone

semanticSweep.description: let the model see the names of each kind and propose groups the string matcher cannot (synonyms, translations); the proposals are judged with evidence like the band

judged.description: pairs the model was asked about

candidates.description: pairs from the wider band the model was shown

failedRequests.description: model requests that answered nothing usable; their pairs are marked unsure

retries.description: extra requests made because an answer was cut off at the token limit and the batch was re-asked in smaller pieces

batchSize.description: pairs per request actually used after sizing by the token budget

targeted.description: true when groupIds, minConfidence or includeCandidates narrowed the review

groupsJudged.description: scan groups the model was asked about

groupsSkipped.description: scan groups returned without a verdict because the targeting left them out

excerpts.description: entities whose document excerpts were fetched as evidence

escalated.description: pairs the model called unsure that were asked once more with excerpts

spellingRules.description: pairs settled by the matcher's hard tiers (exact, umlaut, legal form) without asking the model

stopped.description: true when the review ended before every pair was judged; the verdicts it did reach are in the groups

stopReason.description: why a stopped review ended; null when it ran through

pairsNotJudged.description: pairs that were due but never reached the model because the review stopped

sweepRequests.description: model requests the semantic sweep made (names only)

sweepProposals.description: pairs the sweep proposed that the string matcher had not; they were judged with evidence like any candidate

verdictsReused.description: pairs answered from the judge's memory of earlier verdicts instead of a model request

concurrency.description: model requests the review kept in flight at once

AiReviewProgress.description: Where a running review is. Every field is present; a count that is not known yet is null.

message.description: one line for the page, e.g. "Asking the model, request 3 of 8"

kind.description: the kind being worked on, null between kinds

requestsPlanned.description: requests the plan expects for the whole review; grows when a cut-off answer is re-asked in halves

pairsTotal.description: pairs the review will ask about across all kinds

tokens.description: tokens spent so far, prompt and completion

tokenBudget.description: the configured ceiling for this review; null when there is none

estimatedTokens.description: what the plan expects the whole review to cost, known once the batches are sized

etaMs.description: the remaining time the request rate so far suggests; null before the first request answered

requestPairs.description: pairs in the request that is being answered right now; null between requests

requestAnswers.description: verdicts that have arrived so far in the current request, read off the streamed answer

requestTokens.description: completion tokens the current request has produced so far, streamed or estimated

thinking.description: true while the model is writing reasoning rather than its answer

batchSize.description: pairs per request the judge is using now; changes once after the warm-up measured the model

calibrated.description: true once the batch size and the answer cap come from a measurement of this model rather than from defaults

concurrency.description: model requests kept in flight at once

inFlight.description: model requests waiting for an answer right now

verdictsReused.description: pairs answered from remembered verdicts so far

thinkingTokens.description: reasoning tokens of the current request so far, estimated from the reasoning text; null when the model wrote none

AiReviewJob.description: One AI review running on the server, or the last one that finished. There is at most one at a time.

task.description: what the job runs; the Simplify tags page starts the vocabulary and splits tasks through the same runner

error.description: the message of a failed review

hasResult.description: true when the job carries a DuplicateAiReviewResult (done, or stopped with partial verdicts)

AiReviewJobEvent.description: One server-sent event of a review job. The stream ends after done, stopped or failed.

data.description: the DuplicateAiReviewResult on done and on stopped (partial); absent otherwise

ids.description: unused objects to delete; an object that carries a document by now is refused, not deleted

logId.description: the merge-log row (action delete) that an undo re-creates the objects from

EntityNameMapping.description: document analysis proposed a name and the creation guard used an existing object instead

reason.description: the matcher tier that linked the names

TagVocabularyEntry.description: One entry of the target vocabulary of "Simplify tags"

dimension.description: type is a document type, topic is a tag

paperlessId.description: the document type or tag in Paperless-ngx once it exists

TagVocabulary.description: The vocabulary the archive should end up with, by dimension

TagVocabularyRequest.description: The vocabulary as the user saves it; names only, order kept

TagSplitProposal.description: What one tag stands for, as proposed by a rule, the model or the user

typeName.description: the document type the tag encodes, null when it encodes none

documentsWithType.description: documents of the tag that already carry a different document type; they keep it unless overwriteType is set

TagSplitProposalPatch.description: What the user may change on a proposal

tagIds.description: proposals to apply, by tag id; at most 200 per call

typeSet.description: documents whose document type was set

typeKept.description: documents that kept a differing document type

ids.description: every pair among these ids is stored as "not a duplicate"

names.description: optional id -> name map, stored with the pairs so the list stays readable

get.summary: Issue a CSRF token for the current browser
get.description:
Returns a token paired with the CSRF cookie this response sets, for a
page whose own token has gone stale.

A token is minted per page render and the cookie it pairs with belongs
to the browser, not the tab — so a second tab, a navigation, or the
restart after saving settings leaves every older tab holding a token
the server no longer accepts. /js/csrf.js calls this after a rejected
request and repeats the request once.

Deliberately unauthenticated: the login form needs the same recovery,
and a token is only usable together with the cookie sent alongside it.

200.description: A token matching the cookie set on this response

get.description:
Returns the complete OpenAPI specification for the Zettelrobbe API.
This endpoint attempts to serve a static OpenAPI JSON file first, falling back
to dynamically generating the specification if the file cannot be read.

The OpenAPI specification document contains all API endpoints, parameters,
request bodies, responses, and schemas for the entire application.

302.description: Redirect to login when authentication is missing or invalid

500.description: Server error occurred while retrieving the OpenAPI specification

get.description: Backward-compatible redirect to `/api-docs/openapi.json`.

get.summary: UI framework styleguide page (development builds only)
get.description:
Renders one sample of every zr framework component. The route is only
registered when `NODE_ENV` is not `production`; a production build
answers this path with the generic 404 handler.

302.description: Redirect to login when authentication is missing or invalid

404.description: Route not registered because the app runs in production

get.summary: Root endpoint that redirects to the dashboard
get.description:
This endpoint serves as the entry point for the application.
When accessed, it automatically redirects the user to the dashboard page.
No parameters or authentication are required for this redirection.

get.summary: Render login page or redirect to setup if no users exist
get.description:
Serves the login page for user authentication to the Zettelrobbe application.
If no users exist in the database, the endpoint automatically redirects to the setup page
to complete the initial application configuration.

This endpoint handles both new user sessions and returning users whose
sessions have expired.

schema.description: HTML content of the login page

302.description: Redirect to setup page if no users exist, or to dashboard if already authenticated

post.summary: Authenticate user with username and password
post.description:
Authenticates a user using their username and password credentials.
The endpoint supports a preparation flow for MFA:
first step validates credentials and starts an MFA challenge,
second step accepts a TOTP authentication code and completes sign-in.
If authentication is successful, a JWT token is generated and stored in a secure HTTP-only
cookie for subsequent requests.

Failed login attempts are logged for security purposes, and multiple failures
may result in temporary account lockout depending on configuration.

mfaStep.description: Set to '1' when submitting the MFA step

mfaToken.description: One-time code entered in the MFA verification step

200.description: Login page rendered again for invalid credentials, pending MFA verification, or invalid MFA code

302.description: Authentication successful and redirected to dashboard

429.description: Too many login attempts; login temporarily rate-limited

get.summary: Log out user and clear JWT cookie
get.description:
Terminates the current user session by invalidating and clearing the JWT authentication
cookie. After logging out, the user is redirected to the login page.

This endpoint also clears any session-related data stored on the server side
for the current user.

302.description: Logout successful, redirected to login page

schema.description: HTTP-only cookie with cleared JWT token and immediate expiration

get.summary: Get sample data for a document
get.description:
Retrieves sample data extracted from a document, including processed text content
and any metadata that has been extracted or processed by the AI.

This endpoint is commonly used for previewing document data in the UI before
completing document processing or updating metadata.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Document ID to retrieve sample data for

content.description: Extracted text content from the document
content.example: Invoice from Acme Corp. Total amount: $125.00, Due date: 2023-08-15

metadata.description: Any metadata that has been extracted from the document

get.description:
Renders the AI playground page for experimenting with document analysis.

This interactive environment allows users to test different AI providers and prompts
on document content without affecting the actual document processing workflow.
Users can paste document text, customize prompts, and see raw AI responses
to better understand how the AI models analyze document content.

The playground is useful for fine-tuning prompts and testing AI capabilities
before applying them to actual document processing.

Deprecated: the page has been removed from the navigation and will be
removed entirely in a future release. Use /manual to try a prompt
against a single document.

schema.description: HTML content of the AI playground interface

get.description: Searches Paperless-ngx documents for Manual/OCR document selectors.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query. For mode=id this must be a positive integer document ID.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Search mode (id uses exact Paperless document ID lookup).

tags.description: Resolved tag names for the document.

get.description: Returns documents and metadata required to initialize the AI playground UI. Removed from the navigation and scheduled for removal.

Retrieves the thumbnail image for a specific document from the Paperless-ngx system.
This endpoint proxies the request to the Paperless-ngx API and returns the thumbnail
image for display in the UI.

The thumbnail is returned as an image file in the format provided by Paperless-ngx,
typically JPEG or PNG.

parameters.name: documentId
parameters.description: ID of the document to retrieve thumbnail for

500.description: Server error or Paperless-ngx connection failure

get.description:
Renders the document history page with filtering options.
This page displays a list of all documents that have been processed by Zettelrobbe,
showing the changes made to the documents through AI processing.

The page includes filtering capabilities by correspondent, tag, and free text search,
allowing users to easily find specific documents or categories of processed documents.
Each entry includes links to the original document in Paperless-ngx.

schema.description: HTML content of the history page with filtering controls and document list

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of documents that have been processed by Zettelrobbe.
Supports filtering by tag, correspondent, and search term.
Designed for integration with DataTables jQuery plugin.

This endpoint provides comprehensive information about each processed document,
including its metadata before and after AI processing, allowing users to track
changes made by the system.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Number of records to return per page

parameters.name: search[value]
parameters.description: Global search term (searches title, correspondent and tags)

parameters.name: order[0][column]
parameters.description: Index of column to sort by (0=document_id, 1=title, etc.)

recordsTotal.description: Total number of records in the database

created_at.description: Date and time when the processing occurred

link.description: Link to the document in Paperless-ngx

get.summary: Load history data with progress updates (Server-Sent Events)
get.description:
Preloads history and tag data with real-time progress updates via SSE.
This endpoint should be called before displaying the history table to warm up the cache.
Requires authentication via JWT token or API key.

schema.example:
data: {"type":"progress","percentage":10,"message":"Loading history entries..."}

data: {"type":"complete","message":"Loaded 150 documents with 25 tags","count":150}

post.summary: Reset all processed documents
post.description:
Deletes all processing records from the database, allowing documents to be processed again.
This doesn't delete the actual documents from Paperless-ngx, only their processing status in Zettelrobbe.

This operation can be useful when changing AI models or prompts, as it allows reprocessing
all documents with the updated configuration.

post.summary: Clear tag cache
post.description: Forces cache invalidation to load fresh filter data on next request

429.description: Too many requests - rate limit exceeded

get.description: Returns full stored AI output details and a live diff view against current Paperless metadata.

post.summary: Restore document to pre-AI state
post.description: Restores title, tags, correspondent and related metadata from saved original values.

post.summary: Reset one document for reprocessing
post.description:
Resolves the document in Paperless-ngx first and only then removes its
local tracking records, so it is processed again in a subsequent scan.
A document that cannot be resolved — deleted, or Paperless-ngx briefly
unavailable — leaves every local record untouched and answers 404.

404.description: Document could not be retrieved from Paperless-ngx; nothing was changed

post.summary: Rescan (reprocess) multiple documents by ID
post.description:
Forces reprocessing of the given documents regardless of the configured
scan tag filters. The local processing record is cleared and each document
is enqueued for direct AI processing, bypassing PROCESS_PREDEFINED_DOCUMENTS
/ TAGS scan-scope rules. Processing runs in the background.

post.summary: Manually clear the centralized tag cache
post.description: Forces the tag cache to refresh on next access. Useful after external tag modifications.

429.description: Too many requests - rate limit exceeded (max 10 requests per 15 minutes)

get.description: Returns current thumbnail cache count and total size from local cache storage.

post.summary: Clear thumbnail cache
post.description: Deletes all cached thumbnail PNG files from local cache storage and returns cleanup stats.

429.description: Too many requests - rate limit exceeded

post.summary: Reset local runtime overrides
post.description:
Removes local runtime override values so injected environment variables are used after restart.
This operation is restricted to interactive user sessions and requires the current account password.

currentPassword.description: Current password of the signed-in settings user

post.summary: Manually trigger history reconciliation (Server-Sent Events)
post.description:
Triggers an immediate reconciliation pass that removes stale entries from the
local AI database for documents that have been deleted in Paperless-ngx.
Uses Server-Sent Events (SSE) to stream real-time progress.
Returns a single result event with the number of removed entries.

A pass that refused to delete anything — a scan is running, Paperless-ngx
is unreachable or unauthorized, the document list came back incomplete or
empty — carries `skipped: true`, `removed: 0` and a `message` naming the
reason. Nothing was changed in that case.

schema.example:
data: {"type":"complete","skipped":false,"removed":3,"durationMs":120,"message":"Removed 3 stale entries."}
data: {"type":"complete","skipped":true,"removed":0,"durationMs":8,"message":"Paperless-ngx is not reachable or the token was rejected; nothing was changed."}

post.summary: Reset specific documents
post.description:
Deletes processing records for specific documents, allowing them to be processed again.
This doesn't delete the actual documents from Paperless-ngx, only their processing status in Zettelrobbe.

This operation is useful when you want to reprocess only selected documents after changes to
the AI model, prompt, or document metadata configuration.

ids.description: Array of document IDs to reset

get.summary: Validate history entries against Paperless-ngx (Server-Sent Events)
get.description:
Checks each history entry stored locally and verifies the corresponding document still exists in Paperless-ngx.
Uses Server-Sent Events (SSE) to stream real-time progress updates.
Processes documents in parallel batches (50 at a time) for faster validation.
Returns progress updates and final list of missing documents.

post.summary: Trigger immediate document scan
post.description:
Initiates an immediate scan of documents in Paperless-ngx that haven't been processed yet.
This endpoint can be used to manually trigger processing without waiting for the scheduled interval.

The scan will:
- Connect to Paperless-ngx API
- Fetch all unprocessed documents
- Process each document with the configured AI service
- Update documents in Paperless-ngx with generated metadata

The process respects the function limitations set in the configuration.

400.description: Setup has not been completed yet

post.summary: Request graceful stop for active scan
post.description:
Requests a graceful stop of the currently running scan.
The current document is allowed to finish processing before the scan exits.

post.summary: Regenerate API key
post.description:
Generates a new random API key for the application and updates the .env file.
The previous API key will be invalidated immediately after generation.

This API key can be used for programmatic access to the API endpoints
by sending it in the `x-api-key` header of subsequent requests.

**Security Notice**: This operation invalidates any existing API key.
All systems using the previous key will need to be updated.

get.description:
Renders the application setup page for initial configuration.

This page allows configuring the connection to Paperless-ngx, AI services,
and other application settings. It loads existing configuration if available
and redirects to dashboard if setup is already complete.

The setup page is the entry point for new installations and guides users through
the process of connecting to Paperless-ngx, configuring AI providers, and setting up
admin credentials.

200.description: Setup page rendered successfully (only while no administrator account exists)

schema.description: HTML content of the application setup page

302.description: Redirects away from the wizard once an administrator account exists - to /settings for a signed-in request, otherwise to /login.

get.summary: Get AI provider presets for initial setup

post.summary: Start setup MFA provisioning
Confirm setup MFA code
Test Paperless-ngx connectivity and permissions during setup
Fetch Paperless-ngx counts and tags for setup wizard
Test AI provider credentials during setup
Discover available AI models during setup
Test OCR provider connectivity during setup
Discover available OCR models during setup
post.description:
Returns every discovered model that is not embedding-only. Vision
support is detected from the model name, which recognizes families
such as llava or pixtral and misses OCR-capable models with
unremarkable names, so it ranks the list instead of filtering it:
`visionModels` and `suggestedModel` are hints for the UI, not a

models.description: Every selectable OCR model (embedding-only models excluded)

visionModels.description: Subset of models whose name indicates vision support; absent for providers without model classification

suggestedModel.description: Recommended default; absent for providers without model classification

200.description: Detection result with classified models and suggestions

400.description: Detection failed (unreachable URL, blocked URL, or no compatible API)

Discover available OCR models from the settings page
post.description:
Returns every discovered model that is not embedding-only. Vision
support is detected from the model name, which recognizes families
such as llava or pixtral and misses OCR-capable models with
unremarkable names, so it ranks the list instead of filtering it:
`visionModels` and `suggestedModel` are hints for the UI, not a
restriction on what may be selected.

apiKey.description: Omit or leave empty to use the stored OCR_API_KEY / MISTRAL_API_KEY

suggestedModel.description: Recommended default; absent for providers without model classification

apiKey.description: Omit or leave empty to use the stored CUSTOM_API_KEY / OLLAMA_API_KEY

200.description: Detection result with classified models and suggestions

post.summary: Finalize initial setup, persist env config, and trigger restart
post.description: Validates the Paperless, AI and OCR connections before writing the configuration. The boolean body flags paperlessTestPassed, aiTestPassed and ocrTestPassed let a caller that has just verified a connection with these exact values skip the matching probe; anything not flagged is validated here. allowFailedPaperlessTest and allowFailedAiTest still accept a connection whose validation failed.

403.description: An administrator account already exists. The wizard is closed for good on this instance; nothing is validated, written or replaced.

get.description:
Fetches and returns the content of a specific document from Paperless-ngx
for preview in the manual document review interface.

This endpoint retrieves document details including content, title, ID, and tags,
allowing users to view the document text before applying changes or processing
it with AI tools. The document content is retrieved directly from Paperless-ngx
using the system's configured API credentials.

tags.description: Array of tag names assigned to the document

500.description: Server error or Paperless connection error

get.description:
Renders the manual document review page that allows users to browse,
view and manually process documents from Paperless-ngx.

This interface enables users to review documents, view their content, and
manage tags, correspondents, and document metadata without AI assistance.
Users can apply manual changes to documents based on their own judgment,
which is particularly useful for correction or verification of AI-processed documents.

200.description: Manual document review page rendered successfully

schema.description: HTML content of the manual document review interface

get.description:
Retrieves all tags from Paperless-ngx for use in the manual document review interface.

This endpoint returns a complete list of all available tags that can be applied to documents,
including their IDs, names, and colors. The tags are retrieved directly from Paperless-ngx
and used for tag selection in the UI when manually updating document metadata.

500.description: Server error or Paperless connection error

get.description:
Retrieves all documents from Paperless-ngx for display in the manual document review interface.

This endpoint returns a list of all available documents that can be manually reviewed,
including their basic metadata such as ID, title, and creation date. The documents are
retrieved directly from Paperless-ngx and presented in the UI for selection and processing.

500.description: Server error or Paperless connection error

get.description:
Retrieves the list of correspondents with their document counts.
This endpoint returns all correspondents in the system along with
the number of documents associated with each correspondent.

200.description: List of correspondents with document counts retrieved successfully

count.description: Number of documents associated with this correspondent

get.description:
Retrieves the list of tags with their document counts.
This endpoint returns all tags in the system along with
the number of documents associated with each tag.

200.description: List of tags with document counts retrieved successfully

count.description: Number of documents associated with this tag

post.summary: Webhook for document updates
post.description:
Processes incoming webhook notifications from Paperless-ngx about document
changes, additions, or deletions. The webhook allows Zettelrobbe to respond
to document changes in real-time.

When a new document is added or updated in Paperless-ngx, this endpoint can
trigger automatic AI processing for metadata extraction.

processing_queued.description: Whether AI processing was queued for this document

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

get.description:
Renders the main dashboard page of the application with summary statistics and visualizations.
The dashboard provides an overview of processed documents, system metrics, and important statistics
about document processing including tag counts, correspondent counts, and token usage.

The page displays visualizations for document processing status, token distribution,
processing time statistics, and document type categorization to help administrators
understand system performance and document processing patterns.

schema.description: HTML content of the dashboard page

get.description:
Returns all aggregate counters and chart datasets required by the dashboard UI.

The payload is served from an in-memory cache instead of being rebuilt per
request. It is refreshed in the background (once a minute, plus after every
scan run) and expires after STATS_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS (default 60). The scan
loop invalidates it for every document it processes, so figures follow
processing without polling Paperless-ngx on every request.

cachedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds at which the returned payload was assembled. 0 when the assembly time is unknown.

openai_data.description: Token averages and the overall token total.

get.description:
Renders the application settings page where users can modify configuration
after initial setup.

This page allows administrators to update connections to Paperless-ngx,
AI provider settings, processing parameters, feature toggles, and custom fields.
The interface provides validation for connection settings and displays the current
configuration values.

Changes made on this page require application restart to take full effect.

schema.description: HTML content of the application settings page

post.summary: Update application settings
post.description:
Updates the configuration settings of the Zettelrobbe application after initial setup.
This endpoint allows administrators to modify connections to Paperless-ngx,
AI provider settings, processing parameters, and feature toggles.

Changes made through this endpoint are applied immediately and affect all future
document processing operations.

paperlessUsername.description: Username for Paperless-ngx (alternative to token authentication)

aiProvider.description: Selected AI provider for document analysis

openaiKey.description: API key for OpenAI (required when aiProvider is 'openai')

openaiModel.description: OpenAI model to use for analysis

ollamaUrl.description: URL for Ollama API (required when aiProvider is 'ollama')

ollamaApiKey.description: Optional bearer token for Ollama endpoints that require authentication (leave empty to keep the configured value)

ollamaModel.description: Ollama model to use for analysis

customApiKey.description: API key for custom LLM provider

customBaseUrl.description: Base URL for custom LLM provider

customModel.description: Model name for custom LLM provider

scanInterval.description: Interval in minutes for scanning new documents

reconciliationInterval.description: Cron expression for the reconciliation schedule

systemPrompt.description: Custom system prompt for document analysis
systemPrompt.example: Extract key information from the following document...

showTags.description: Whether to show tags in the UI

tokenLimit.description: The maximum number of tokens th AI can handle

responseTokens.description: Tokens a provider may spend on its answer. Reserved in the context window and sent as the generation limit (num_predict for Ollama, max_tokens elsewhere). Rejected with 400 when it is not a positive whole number.

tags.description: Comma-separated list of tags to use for filtering

aiProcessedTag.description: Whether to add a tag for AI-processed documents

aiTagName.description: Tag name to use for AI-processed documents

usePromptTags.description: Whether to use tags in prompts

promptTags.description: Comma-separated list of tags to use in prompts

useExistingData.description: Whether to use existing data from a previous setup

customFields.description: JSON string defining custom fields to extract

duplicatesAiReview.description: Offer the AI review on the Duplicates page (yes/no). Default yes. Scanning and merging work without it.

duplicatesAiModel.description: Model of the configured provider used only for judging duplicates. Empty means the provider's configured model.

duplicatesAiReviewBatchSize.description: Name pairs per model request (1-100, default 25). Out-of-range values are clamped, a non-numeric value keeps the current setting.

duplicatesAiCandidateFloor.description: Lowest matcher score a pair needs to be shown to the model (0.50-0.95, default 0.6). Out-of-range values are clamped, a non-numeric value keeps the current setting.

duplicatesAiExcerpts.description: Send document excerpts for pairs the matcher linked by spelling alone (yes/no). Default yes.

duplicatesAiExcerptChars.description: Excerpt length in characters (50-500, default 300). Out-of-range values are clamped, a non-numeric value keeps the current setting.

duplicatesAiExcerptDocuments.description: Documents sampled per tag or correspondent for those excerpts (1-5, default 2). Out-of-range values are clamped, a non-numeric value keeps the current setting.

duplicatesAiTokenBudget.description: The most one AI review may spend across all its requests, prompt and completion (0-10000000, default 200000). When it is reached the review stops itself and keeps the verdicts it has; 0 means no limit. Out-of-range values are clamped, a non-numeric value keeps the current setting.

duplicatesAiIdleStopSeconds.description: A running review that no page has been watching for this many seconds stops itself, so a closed tab cannot leave the model running (0-3600, default 60). 0 means never. Out-of-range values are clamped, a non-numeric value keeps the current setting.

duplicatesAiThinking.description: Let the judge reason before it answers (yes/no). Default no; a reasoning model otherwise spends the whole answer budget on its thoughts before the first verdict.

duplicatesAiRequestSeconds.description: How long one model request should take (5-300 seconds, default 30). The judge measures the model on a small first request and then sizes every later one to fit. Out-of-range values are clamped, a non-numeric value keeps the current setting.

duplicatesAiConcurrency.description: Model requests the judge keeps in flight at once (0-8, default 0). 0 lets the judge choose: one for Ollama, three for a hosted endpoint. Wall time divides by it, tokens do not. Out-of-range values are clamped, a non-numeric value keeps the current setting.

duplicatesAiVerdictMemoryDays.description: How long a verdict about a pair of names is remembered (0-365 days, default 90). A pair the model judged is not asked again while both names are unchanged; 0 switches the memory off. Out-of-range values are clamped, a non-numeric value keeps the current setting.

duplicatesGuardNewNames.description: Reuse an existing tag or correspondent when document analysis proposes the same name in another spelling (yes/no). Default yes; the mapping is listed on the Duplicates page.

duplicatesAiSweepNames.description: How many names the model sees per request when the semantic sweep looks at the whole list (50-1000, default 300). Out-of-range values are clamped, a non-numeric value keeps the current setting.

simplifyTagsPerRequest.description: How many tag names one model request of "Simplify tags" decomposes into a document type and topic tags (10-200, default 50). Out-of-range values are clamped, a non-numeric value keeps the current setting.

simplifyVocabularySize.description: How many entries the vocabulary proposed from the tag names should aim at, types and topics together (5-100, default 25). Out-of-range values are clamped, a non-numeric value keeps the current setting.

ocrAutoProcessInterval.description: Cron expression for the automatic OCR queue schedule

ocrAutoProcessBatchSize.description: Maximum queued documents handled per automatic OCR run (1-100)

ocrAutoAnalyze.description: Run AI analysis directly after automatic OCR (yes/no)

dateFormat.description: How every date in the web interface is rendered

message.example: Invalid settings: AI provider required when automatic processing is enabled
Failed to update settings: Database error

get.description:
Returns the currently active application API key for authenticated users.
The key is intentionally fetched on-demand and is not embedded in server-rendered HTML.

configured.description: Indicates whether an API key is currently configured

apiKey.description: Current API key value when configured

get.summary: Get MFA status for current user
get.description: Returns whether TOTP MFA is enabled for the authenticated settings user.

post.summary: Start MFA setup and return provisioning data
post.description: Validates current password and creates a temporary TOTP setup challenge including local QR image data.

post.summary: Enable MFA after validating TOTP code
post.description: Validates current password and setup token, verifies TOTP code, then enables MFA.

post.summary: Verify a TOTP code for an already enabled MFA setup
post.description: Validates an entered TOTP code against the stored user MFA secret.

post.summary: Disable MFA for current user
post.description: Validates current password and a valid TOTP code, then disables MFA for the user.

get.description: Detects and returns the public base URL used for document links.

post.summary: Analyze document content manually
post.description:
Analyzes document content using the configured AI provider and returns structured metadata.
This endpoint processes the document text to extract relevant information such as tags,
correspondent, and document type based on content analysis.

The analysis is performed using the AI provider configured in the application settings.

content.description: The document text content to analyze
content.example: Invoice from Acme Corp. Total amount: $125.00, Due date: 2023-08-15

existingTags.description: List of existing tags in the system to help with tag matching

id.description: Optional document ID for tracking metrics

500.description: Server error or AI provider not configured

post.summary: Process document using a custom prompt in playground mode (deprecated)
post.description:
Analyzes document content using a custom user-provided prompt.
This endpoint is primarily used for testing and experimenting with different prompts
without affecting the actual document processing workflow.

The analysis is performed using the AI provider configured in the application settings,
but with a custom prompt that overrides the default system prompt.

content.description: The document text content to analyze
content.example: Invoice from Acme Corp. Total amount: $125.00, Due date: 2023-08-15

prompt.description: Custom prompt to use for analysis
prompt.example: Extract the company name, invoice amount, and due date from this document.

documentId.description: Optional document ID for tracking metrics

200.description: Document analysis results using the custom prompt

result.description: The raw AI response using the custom prompt
result.example:
Company: Acme Corp
Amount: $125.00
Due Date: 2023-08-15

500.description: Server error or AI provider not configured

post.summary: Update document metadata in Paperless-ngx
post.description:
Updates document metadata such as tags, correspondent and title in the Paperless-ngx system.
This endpoint handles the translation between tag names and IDs, and manages the creation of
new tags or correspondents if they don't exist in the system.

The endpoint also removes any unused tags from the document to keep the metadata clean.

documentId.description: ID of the document to update in Paperless-ngx

tags.description: List of tags to apply (can be tag IDs or names)

correspondent.description: Correspondent name to assign to the document

400.description: Invalid request parameters or tag processing errors

example: Failed to create tag: Invalid tag name

get.description:
Reports database connectivity **and** whether the document scanner is
actually able to work. Used by the Docker healthcheck and monitoring.

`status` is `healthy` when the database is reachable and the scanner is
operational, `degraded` when automatic processing is enabled but the
scan loop is not armed or has failed `failureThreshold` runs in a row
(for example because Paperless-ngx is unreachable), and `database_error`
when the local database cannot be queried.

A `degraded` state answers with HTTP 503 unless `HEALTHCHECK_STRICT=no`
is configured, in which case the details are reported with HTTP 200.
When automatic processing is switched off via
`DISABLE_AUTOMATIC_PROCESSING=yes`, a missing scan loop is expected and
never reported as degraded.

503.description:
Service unavailable — either the database check failed
(`database_error`) or the scanner is degraded (`degraded`).

get.description:
Returns the current status of document processing operations.
This endpoint provides information about documents in the processing queue
and the current processing state (active/idle).

The status information can be used by UIs to display progress indicators
and provide real-time feedback about background processing operations.

isProcessing.description: Whether documents are currently being processed

isScanning.description: Whether a scan loop is currently running

stopRequested.description: Whether a graceful stop has been requested

currentlyProcessing.description: Details about the document currently being processed (if any)

get.summary: Get document IDs currently waiting in the OCR queue
get.description: Returns the Paperless-ngx document IDs with status pending or processing. Used by the OCR view to hide already queued documents from search results.

post.summary: Add document to OCR queue
post.description: Queues documents for OCR on explicit request. A document that has already been through OCR, and one that has already been analysed, is queued again, because the request itself is the user asking for a re-run; a completed queue row goes back to pending and its stored OCR text is cleared. Only a document the OCR worker is busy with is left alone. added counts the documents that really are pending afterwards, skipped the ones that were left alone, and missing lists the ids Paperless-ngx no longer has.

schema.description: One of documentId or documentIds is required.

documentId.description: A single document, as the row menu sends it.

documentIds.description:
A selection, as the bulk menu sends it. Documents that are
being processed are counted as skipped and ones missing from
Paperless-ngx are listed, rather than failing the batch.

200.description: Add operation result. success is false when a single document was not queued; the counters are present either way.

added.description: Documents that are pending because of this request.

skipped.description: Documents the OCR worker is busy with.

post.summary: Process one OCR queue item
post.description: Starts OCR processing for one document and streams progress via SSE.

post.summary: Process all pending OCR queue items
post.description: Starts batch OCR processing and streams progress via SSE.

post.summary: Analyze existing OCR text with AI
post.description: Uses existing OCR text and streams analysis progress via SSE.

get.summary: Get OCR text for one queue item

post.summary: Reset permanently failed document
Reset all permanently failed documents
Add one or more documents to the ignored list
post.description:
Ignored documents are skipped by every future scan. Accepts a single
id from the history row menu or a selection from its bulk menu; a
document that was already ignored counts as skipped rather than an
error.

schema.description: One of documentId or documentIds is required.

title.description: Stored with a single document; ignored for a selection.

200.description: How many were added and how many were already ignored

400.description: No usable document id in the payload

get.description:
Renders the Duplicates page. The page scans on request through
`/api/duplicates/scan`; nothing runs automatically.

get.summary: Find tags or correspondents whose names mean the same thing
get.description:
Loads every tag and/or correspondent from Paperless-ngx and groups the
ones that look like duplicates of each other. Read-only: nothing is
changed, and pairs the user marked as "not a duplicate" are left out
unless `includeDismissed` asks for them.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: score a pair needs, between 0.5 and 1

post.summary: Let the configured AI provider judge what the scan found
post.description:
Runs the same scan as `/api/duplicates/scan`, shows the configured AI
provider every pair of the groups plus a wider band of near-misses,
and returns the scan result with the model's verdict attached to each
group and member. Groups the model confirmed below the sensitivity
arrive as extra groups with `source: ai-candidate`.

Read-only and never automatic: it runs when the user asks for it,
nothing is merged, and a verdict is information the user decides on.

Two options say how much the model gets to see. `withTitles` gives it
a few recent document titles per entry and the entries it is usually
filed with; `withExcerpts` adds the beginning of a couple of documents
per entry, but only for the pairs the matcher linked by spelling alone
("Kontoauszug" / "Kontoumzug"), which is where names and titles are
not enough. Both default to on; `withExcerpts` is capped by
DUPLICATES_AI_EXCERPTS, DUPLICATES_AI_EXCERPT_CHARS and
DUPLICATES_AI_EXCERPT_DOCUMENTS. `aiReview.excerpts` reports how many
entries were read.

The review can be targeted, which is what makes it cheap on a large
archive: `groupIds` names the scan groups to judge, `minConfidence`
judges only groups scoring at least that much, and
`includeCandidates: false` leaves the band of near-misses out
entirely. Together they narrow the question, not the answer — every
group of the scan still comes back, the ones nobody asked about with
`aiVerdict: null` on the group and its members. A group id this scan
does not know is ignored. `aiReview.targeted`, `aiReview.groupsJudged`
and `aiReview.groupsSkipped` report what the targeting did.

This route runs the review as the same job
`/api/duplicates/ai-review/jobs` starts and waits for it, so there is
still only one review at a time: while one runs this answers 409 with
the running job. A review that stopped early — by the token budget,
or because somebody pressed Stop — answers 200 with the verdicts it
reached and `aiReview.stopped`.

400.description:
Unknown kind, threshold outside [0.5, 1], `groupIds` that is not a
list of at most 500 non-empty strings, `minConfidence` outside
[0.5, 1] or an `includeCandidates` that is not a boolean

409.description:
The AI review is switched off (DUPLICATES_AI_REVIEW), or another
review is already running; in the second case `data.job` names it

502.description: Paperless-ngx or the AI provider could not be reached

post.summary: Start an AI review as a job the page can watch and stop
post.description:
Starts the same review `POST /api/duplicates/ai-review` runs, but
answers at once with the job instead of waiting for it. The page then
follows it through `/api/duplicates/ai-review/jobs/{id}/events` and
can end it through `/api/duplicates/ai-review/jobs/{id}/stop`.

There is at most one review at a time. While one runs this answers
409 and carries the running job, so a second tab attaches to it
instead of failing.

The body is validated exactly as the synchronous route validates it.

400.description: The same refusals the synchronous review answers

409.description: A review is already running; `data.job` is that one

get.summary: The AI review that is running, or the last one that finished
get.description:
What a reloaded page asks first: `job` is the running review, the one
still winding down after a stop, or the last finished one while it is
retained, and `null` when there is none. Reading it counts as watching
the review, so a page that polls keeps it alive.

get.summary: One AI review job, with its result once it has one
get.description:
The polling fallback for a page whose event stream a proxy cut: it
carries the same job and, once the review ended, the same result the
stream would have delivered. Reading it counts as watching the review.

200.description: The job and, when it has one, its result

get.summary: The result of a finished job, on its own
get.description:
What the stream delivered with its `done` (or partial `stopped`)
event, without the job around it. The Duplicates page reads the review
result off the stream; this is for the Simplify tags page, whose two
tasks answer with something small — a proposed vocabulary, the counts
of a proposal run — that is worth asking for again after a reload.

A job that is still running has no result yet and answers 409.

data.description: the DuplicateAiReviewResult of a review, or what a Simplify tags task returned

get.summary: Follow an AI review as server-sent events
get.description:
One `AiReviewJobEvent` per `data:` line. The first event is the job as
it is right now, so a page that attaches late does not wait for the
next change; then one `progress` event per report of the judge; then
exactly one of `done`, `stopped` or `failed`, after which the stream
ends. A comment line every 15 seconds keeps the connection open
through proxies that close a quiet stream.

An open stream is what keeps the review alive: a job nobody watches
stops itself after DUPLICATES_AI_IDLE_STOP_SECONDS.

post.summary: Stop a running AI review
post.description:
Asks the review to end after the request it is in. What it has judged
so far is kept: the job ends as `stopped` and carries the partial
result, which the stream delivers like a complete one. Stopping a
review that already finished changes nothing and still answers with
the job.

200.description: The job, now stopping or already finished

delete.summary: Forget every remembered verdict of the AI judge
delete.description:
The judge remembers what it decided about a pair of names for
DUPLICATES_AI_VERDICT_MEMORY_DAYS, so the next review only asks about
what is new. This empties that memory, which makes the next review ask
about everything again — the thing to do after the model changed or
after a verdict turned out to be wrong.

Local only: nothing in Paperless-ngx is touched, and no merge is
undone or repeated.

get.summary: Every tag or correspondent of the instance
get.description:
The list the "Merge by hand" module picks from. Read-only: it loads
one kind from Paperless-ngx and hands the records back sorted by name,
case-insensitively, so entries that differ only in case sit next to
each other. Nothing is grouped, scored or filtered here.

Unlike the scan, `kind` is required — there is no "both" list.

post.summary: Merge tags or correspondents into one
post.description:
Moves the documents of every source onto the target and deletes the
sources afterwards, one source after the other. A source is only
deleted once Paperless-ngx confirms that no document carries it any
more; a source that fails that check is reported and kept.

`targetName` renames the survivor before the documents move, so the
group can end up under a name none of its members had. The old name is
kept in the log entry (`targetRenamedFrom`) and an undo puts it back.

The answer carries `success: false` with status 200 when the merge was
only partial — the log entry exists either way and can be undone.

400.description: Invalid request, or targetName longer than 128 characters

404.description: Target or a source does not exist in Paperless-ngx

409.description: A document scan is running, or targetName is already taken

post.summary: Delete tags or correspondents that carry no document
post.description:
Removes objects the scan listed as unused. Every id is checked against
Paperless-ngx first: an object that carries a document by now is
refused and kept, never deleted. What was deleted is written to the
merge log as one entry with `action: delete`, so the same undo
re-creates the objects — with new ids, as any undo does.

The answer carries `success: false` with status 200 when at least one
object could not be deleted; the deleted ones are in `data.deleted`
either way.

400.description: Unknown kind, or ids missing, empty, malformed or longer than 500

post.summary: Mark entries as "not a duplicate"
post.description:
Stores every pair among the given ids, so the scan stops offering them
together until the pair is restored through
`DELETE /api/duplicates/dismissals/{id}`.

dismissed.description: pairs newly stored; known pairs are not counted again

get.summary: List the pairs marked as "not a duplicate"

delete.summary: Restore a pair marked as "not a duplicate"
delete.description: The pair is offered by the scan again from the next run on.

get.description:
Every merge this instance performed, newest first, with everything an
undo needs. `recordsTotal` counts the rows matching the filter.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description:
Keeps only the rows that record this action. The local model pages
the log by kind alone, so the action is applied in the route over
the newest 2000 rows; `recordsTotal` counts what matched inside
that window.

post.summary: Undo a logged merge
post.description:
Re-creates every source the merge deleted — a same-named object that
exists again is adopted instead — and hands back the documents that
still carry the target. Documents that were changed since the merge
are counted as skipped and left alone. The re-created objects get new
ids in Paperless-ngx.

The answer carries `success: false` with status 200 when at least one
source could not be restored.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: id of the merge log entry

409.description: Already undone, or a document scan is running

get.summary: Names document analysis proposed and the guard mapped onto an existing object
get.description:
Every time the creation guard recognised a proposed tag or
correspondent as another spelling of one that exists, it recorded the
mapping. The list is local, newest first, and kept short; it exists so
a wrong mapping can be noticed and the setting turned off.

delete.description:
Clears the local list. Nothing in Paperless-ngx changes: the names were
mapped when the documents were analysed, and this only forgets the
record of it.

get.description:
Renders the page that turns compound tags such as "Stromrechnung" into
a document type ("Rechnung") and topic tags ("Strom"). The vocabulary
and the proposals are read through `/api/simplify/*`; nothing runs
automatically and no split happens without a confirmation.

get.summary: The target vocabulary of document types and topic tags
get.description:
The couple of dozen concepts the archive should end up with, in the
order the user put them in. Local only: these are names, not objects
in Paperless-ngx — an entry gets its `paperlessId` when a split first
needs the object.

put.description:
Stores the vocabulary as the user edited it: names only, the order
kept, blanks and repeats dropped. The ids a name already has in
Paperless-ngx survive the save. A list that is not a list of at most
200 names of at most 128 characters each is refused with 400.

400.description: A list is too long, or holds something that is not a name

post.summary: Let the model propose a vocabulary from the tag names
post.description:
Starts a job that shows the model every tag name and asks for the
couple of dozen document types and topics the archive really has. The
route answers at once with the job; the page follows it through
`/api/duplicates/ai-review/jobs/{id}/events` and reads the proposal
from `/api/duplicates/ai-review/jobs/{id}/result`.

The proposal is not saved: it is shown for editing, and only
`PUT /api/simplify/vocabulary` stores anything.

There is one job at a time for the whole app, shared with the AI
review; while one runs this answers 409 and carries it.

409.description: A job is already running; `data.job` is that one

get.summary: What every tag stands for, as proposed
get.description:
One row per tag the last run looked at, by name. Read-only; the rows
survive a reload and are edited one by one through the PATCH below.

post.summary: Propose for every tag what it stands for
post.description:
Starts a job that decomposes every tag against the saved vocabulary —
first by rule, which needs no model at all, then by the model for what
the rule could not settle. The stored proposals are replaced.

Answers like the vocabulary proposal: 202 with the job, or 409 with
the job that is already running.

fresh.description: ask the model again for tags a rule already settled

409.description: A job is already running; `data.job` is that one

patch.description:
Only the fields the body names are changed. A changed target marks the
proposal as the user's, and `status` may only move between open and
skipped — applying is what the apply route does.

200.description: The proposal as it is stored now

400.description: A field of the patch is of the wrong kind

404.description: There is no proposal for that tag

get.summary: What applying one proposal would do to the documents
get.description:
Read-only: it asks Paperless-ngx how many documents of the tag would
get the topics, how many would get the document type, and how many
already carry a different one and would keep it. The page asks for
every selected tag before it shows the one confirmation of an apply.

typeSet.description: documents whose document type would be set

typeKept.description: documents that carry a differing type and would keep it

404.description: There is no proposal for that tag

501.description: The impact preview is not available on this build

post.summary: Apply the proposals of the named tags
post.description:
One tag after the other: the vocabulary objects are created in
Paperless-ngx where they are missing, the documents of the tag get the
topic tags and — where they carry no document type, or always with
`overwriteType` — the document type, the compound tag is deleted, and
one merge-log row with `action: split` records what happened per
document so an undo can play it back.

The answer carries `success: false` with status 200 when at least one
tag failed; what was applied is in `data.applied` either way, and each
failure names its reason.

400.description: tagIds is missing, empty, too long or not a list of ids

501.description: Applying splits is not available on this build

get.summary: Report whether a newer release is available
get.description:
Compares the running version against the latest GitHub release tag.

The lookup happens on the server and its result is cached for 24 hours,
so browsers never contact GitHub themselves and a busy instance makes at
most one outbound request per day. Set `UPDATE_CHECK_ENABLED=no` to turn
the outbound call off; the endpoint then reports `enabled: false`.

get.summary: Check whether the What's New modal should be shown
get.description: Returns show=true when the authenticated user has not yet seen the current release changelog.

post.summary: Mark the current changelog as seen for the authenticated user

get.summary: Export the running configuration as a .env file
get.description: Returns the instance's configuration as .env lines, grouped by topic and covering only variables that are actually set. Intended for moving an instance or pinning its settings into docker-compose. The body contains API tokens and keys in clear text; JWT_SECRET is deliberately excluded, since a fresh instance generates its own.

get.summary: Read the authenticated user's dashboard configuration
get.description: Returns the stored configuration in storage format v1: the named dashboards the user arranged, each with its widgets in display order, and the slug of the active one. An empty dashboards list means nothing has been customised and every board renders in its default order — the same answer a user without a stored configuration gets.

active.description: Slug of the dashboard currently shown

rows.description: Height in tile rows, 3 to 24, or 0 for as tall as the content

put.summary: Store or reset the authenticated user's dashboard configuration
put.description:
Takes a complete configuration in storage format v1 and replaces the stored one; there is no partial update. Up to 10 dashboards, each with a slug, a name of 1 to 60 characters and up to 50 widgets in display order. Widget spans are 3 to 12 grid columns; rows are 3 to 24 tile rows, or 0 for a card that is as tall as its content. A dashboard without widgets shows the default arrangement under its own name.
Two payloads reset instead of storing: an empty dashboards array, and a single dashboard whose widgets array is empty. Both clear the stored configuration, so every board returns to its default order. Emptying one board out of several does not reset — that board simply shows the defaults and keeps its name.
If active names a dashboard that is not in the payload it is replaced with the first dashboard's slug rather than rejecting the write.

active.description: Slug of the dashboard to show

rows.description: 3 to 24 tile rows, or 0 for as tall as the content
